config.world: A language-model judge (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, local HuggingFace cache on Atlas, revision recorded at sealing) shown a target and two options, each a number, and asked which option is closer to the target; preference read from the next-token log-probabilities of the two answer letters, each pair shown in both orders. The consequence of an option is its distance from the target, known exactly. Two resolution budgets: the rendering precision (decimals shown) and the judge's weight precision (bf16, 8-bit, 4-bit via bitsandbytes).
config.bars: PREREG-G3.md Section 5; tolerances fixed from the pilot before sealing and applied to the run seed only
config.estimator: threshold = the gap at which the pair-averaged preference for the closer option exceeds one half for at least accuracy_level of pairs, interpolated linearly in log gap between ladder points; infinity if never reached
